items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: It was a band in Philadelphia by the name of Buddy Williams that, he got stuck for lead alto and he asked me about it... And started playing lead alto for him and then kept it up for twenty years.
